nodes.norm_label: adr 0002: one data key per object

nodes.label: ADR 0005: A KMS key is a provider
nodes.norm_label: adr 0005: a kms key is a provider

nodes.label: ADR 0021: Key material is generated, never committed
nodes.norm_label: adr 0021: key material is generated, never committed

nodes.label: Ticket 033: out-of-band recovery path for a damaged object
nodes.norm_label: ticket 033: out-of-band recovery path for a damaged object

nodes.label: Adding a KEK provider checklist
nodes.rationale: Fingerprint() must be stable: a stored object names it

nodes.label: Envelope encryption: DEK wrapped by configured KEK
nodes.norm_label: envelope encryption: dek wrapped by configured kek
nodes.rationale: Keys must be replaceable without re-encrypting the bucket; a long-lived key wraps only short-lived keys.

nodes.label: Provider selection by KEK fingerprint
nodes.rationale: No default provider and no trial decryption; a fingerprint matching nothing configured is an error.

nodes.label: KEK is the single point of total loss
nodes.norm_label: kek is the single point of total loss

nodes.label: Key layer fails closed
nodes.rationale: Unwrap failure, unknown fingerprint or missing wrapped key are errors; wrapped-key auth failure is 403 InvalidObjectState, not 5xx.

nodes.label: Key rotation is a configuration procedure
nodes.norm_label: key rotation is a configuration procedure
nodes.rationale: Add provider, repoint alias, restart; removing a provider makes its objects permanently unreadable; restart is part of D7 because config is read once.

nodes.label: Minimal set of decryption inputs (one load-bearing field)
nodes.norm_label: minimal set of decryption inputs (one load-bearing field)
nodes.rationale: Only s3ep-encrypted-dek is an input to the cryptography; wrap-describing metadata is not bound into associated data to keep out-of-band recovery possible.

nodes.label: An object is readable from itself (no key database)
nodes.norm_label: an object is readable from itself (no key database)
nodes.rationale: Wrapped key travels in object metadata so a copied, replicated or restored bucket stays readable and no sidecar can fail.

nodes.label: A read performs at most one unwrap
nodes.norm_label: a read performs at most one unwrap
nodes.rationale: A double unwrap measured ~0.94 ms with an asymmetric key halved a path's throughput; with a KMS it would be a second round trip.

nodes.label: One random 256-bit data key per object
nodes.norm_label: one random 256-bit data key per object
nodes.rationale: Drawn from the system CSPRNG at write time, never reused nor derived from object key, bucket or client input.

nodes.label: s3ep-kek-algorithm metadata key
nodes.rationale: Read only for the failed-lookup diagnostic; kept because a migration between two key encryption algorithms needs provenance.

nodes.label: Stale-key cache defect (identity-keyed cache)
nodes.rationale: Caching by (fingerprint, object key) decrypted re-uploaded objects with the previous DEK.

nodes.label: Bounded unwrapped data key cache
nodes.rationale: Cache key includes a digest of the wrapped key so a re-upload cannot return a stale DEK; correctness by construction, not by write-path invalidation. 1024 entries, no expiry, 64-bit digest.

nodes.label: Tail-first whole-object read and x-amz-checksum-crc32c
nodes.rationale: Reads last 65604 bytes first, rest under If-Match; HEAD reads last 40 bytes; moves trailer faults to refusals before the response, at one extra round trip (~40% on 100 KB).

nodes.label: Wrapped key auth failure answers 403 InvalidObjectState
nodes.norm_label: wrapped key auth failure answers 403 invalidobjectstate
nodes.rationale: A 5xx would make SDKs retry a permanent state and make clients file corruption as a passing outage; transient KMS failures stay 5xx.

nodes.label: aes_key admission: base64 of 32 bytes, not all printable, >=16 distinct values
nodes.norm_label: aes_key admission: base64 of 32 bytes, not all printable, >=16 distinct values
nodes.rationale: Entropy at the source is the only lever on a guessable key; passphrases plus a published fingerprint gave a free offline dictionary oracle.

nodes.label: AES-KWP (RFC 5649) deterministic wrap, rejected
nodes.rationale: Not in the standard library; a wrap format must not depend on a library decision.

nodes.label: aes: the one local key-encryption provider
nodes.norm_label: aes: the one local key-encryption provider

nodes.label: Rejected: sanction passphrases priced with Argon2id
nodes.norm_label: rejected: sanction passphrases priced with argon2id
nodes.rationale: Offline, forever attack against wrapped key plus tag; no work factor survives 40-60 bits of entropy.

nodes.label: Custody of the master key is a separate axis
nodes.norm_label: custody of the master key is a separate axis

nodes.label: AES-256-GCM key wrap with per-wrap salt (76 bytes)
nodes.norm_label: aes-256-gcm key wrap with per-wrap salt (76 bytes)
nodes.rationale: An unauthenticated AES-CTR wrap was malleable; the per-wrap salt removes the 2^32 message bound so no wrap counter is needed.

nodes.label: HKDF-SHA256 derived s3ep-kek-fingerprint
nodes.rationale: Removes the raw hash of the key from metadata; does not remove the offline attack, which is why admission rules are the substantive part.

nodes.label: HKDF labels and wrap AD are format constants independent of the metadata prefix
nodes.norm_label: hkdf labels and wrap ad are format constants independent of the metadata prefix
nodes.rationale: s3ep-kek-fingerprint, s3ep-kek-wrap-v1 and s3ep-dek-wrap-v1 do not follow encryption.metadata_key_prefix.

nodes.label: No key-rotation operation; rotation is a configuration procedure
nodes.norm_label: no key-rotation operation; rotation is a configuration procedure

nodes.label: rsa provider removed
nodes.rationale: Required both key halves in one config (no write-only property), >4000x slower unwrap, RSA-2048 at 112-bit security vulnerable to harvest-now-decrypt-later, own fingerprint defect.

nodes.label: Tampered wrapped key fails with its own error before any byte is decrypted
nodes.norm_label: tampered wrapped key fails with its own error before any byte is decrypted

nodes.label: Custody by injection vs custody in a KMS
nodes.norm_label: custody by injection vs custody in a kms
nodes.rationale: A secrets manager filling ${S3EP_AES_KEY} leaves the key in process memory; calling it KMS custody would be an unhonoured claim.

nodes.label: Data key cache (1024 LRU, no expiry yet)
nodes.norm_label: data key cache (1024 lru, no expiry yet)
nodes.rationale: Load-bearing under a KMS: a miss costs a network call; D10 requires an expiry not yet built.

nodes.label: Demo-stack Vault in development mode (no proxy code talks to it)
nodes.norm_label: demo-stack vault in development mode (no proxy code talks to it)

nodes.label: KMS failure is fail-closed per request, no fallback
nodes.norm_label: kms failure is fail-closed per request, no fallback
nodes.rationale: A fallback is a path on which data is readable without the KMS, defeating the provider.

nodes.label: KMS fingerprint derived from key identity, key version excluded
nodes.norm_label: kms fingerprint derived from key identity, key version excluded
nodes.rationale: Including the version would change the fingerprint after a KMS rotation and lose the provider for the proxy's own objects.

nodes.label: Under a KMS provider the KEK never enters the proxy
nodes.norm_label: under a kms provider the kek never enters the proxy

nodes.label: KMS credentials never live in a configuration file
nodes.norm_label: kms credentials never live in a configuration file

nodes.label: KMS-backed key encryption key provider type (unbuilt)
nodes.norm_label: kms-backed key encryption key provider type (unbuilt)
nodes.rationale: Only route to key custody outside the process; a mode/flag would hide four different contracts (fingerprint, failure, latency, availability).

nodes.label: KMS provider ships after the storage format rewrite, additive
nodes.norm_label: kms provider ships after the storage format rewrite, additive

nodes.label: Unreachable KMS is a startup error
nodes.norm_label: unreachable kms is a startup error
nodes.rationale: Closes the stub's failure mode by construction: no provider around a locally generated key.

nodes.label: tink stub removed before any KMS code
nodes.norm_label: tink stub removed before any kms code
nodes.rationale: The stub discarded address and credentials and minted a random key per construction; reachable, it would have made every object unreadable after restart.

nodes.label: HashiCorp Vault Transit as first KMS backend
nodes.norm_label: hashicorp vault transit as first kms backend

nodes.label: Rotation is the KMS's job and is versioned (vault:vN: prefix)
nodes.norm_label: rotation is the kms's job and is versioned (vault:vn: prefix)

nodes.label: Chart shipped a working default key before 3.8.56
nodes.norm_label: chart shipped a working default key before 3.8.56
nodes.rationale: An install that configured nothing encrypted under a public key and succeeded silently: the worst shape of security defect.

nodes.label: Test fixture and conformance-runner keys still in tree (D1 not met)
nodes.norm_label: test fixture and conformance-runner keys still in tree (d1 not met)

nodes.label: No half of a generated key/certificate pair is tracked (D4)
nodes.norm_label: no half of a generated key/certificate pair is tracked (d4)

nodes.norm_label: no working key material is tracked in the repository (d1)

nodes.label: On-demand key generator writing an ignored env file (D2)
nodes.norm_label: on-demand key generator writing an ignored env file (d2)

nodes.label: Published keys are treated as compromised; rotate, do not delete (D5)
nodes.norm_label: published keys are treated as compromised; rotate, do not delete (d5)
nodes.rationale: Deleting a key from the tree does not un-publish it; history keeps every key ever committed.

nodes.label: Stable key encryption key for the paid run (D8)
nodes.norm_label: stable key encryption key for the paid run (d8)

nodes.label: Minimal set of cryptographically load-bearing inputs
nodes.norm_label: minimal set of cryptographically load-bearing inputs
nodes.rationale: Only master key, s3ep-encrypted-dek, object key, format id and segment index are required; kek-fingerprint is a selector and the algorithm keys are descriptive, so damage there costs recovery nothing. Constraint on future format work.

nodes.label: Reconstructing a session from the backend is foreclosed
nodes.norm_label: reconstructing a session from the backend is foreclosed
nodes.rationale: The wrapped DEK is returned by no UploadId operation; per-part plaintext CRC32C and held bytes are not at the backend; a reconstruction disarms ADR 0011 D2's offset check and lets the hostile backend choose what the trailer authenticates. Deriving the DEK is forbidden by ADR 0002 D1.

nodes.label: Response composed from an allowlist, never proxied
nodes.norm_label: response composed from an allowlist, never proxied
nodes.rationale: Backend checksums describe ciphertext, its Content-Length stored bytes, its metadata the proxy keys; none may reach a client.

nodes.label: s3ep- metadata namespace, filtered out and refused in
nodes.norm_label: s3ep- metadata namespace, filtered out and refused in
nodes.rationale: A client x-amz-meta-s3ep-encrypted-dek used to reach the proxy map through header canonicalisation and won four of ten uploads, leaving objects undecryptable.
